data.narrative:
Hades Mining is a seed-stage frontier technology company in the Climate & Energy sector, founded by Max Werner, Björn Dressler, and Dan Gengenbach. The company has raised $22M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes nine known private peers (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen among them) and one public comparable (LNZA), though few peers occupy the same stage and valuation tier.

Given the limited precision of seed-stage peer multiples in this sector, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised ($22M) as a proxy for current value and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $55M. This single-method approach constrains confidence; peer-median analysis proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum data thresholds.

The triangulated range supported by this analysis spans $47M (low) to $63M (high), with a median point of $55M. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single valuation method and the absence of tighter peer benchmarking. Stage-progression multiples vary materially by sub-sector performance and capital efficiency; absent visibility into Hades Mining's specific unit economics or technical milestones, this range should be treated as preliminary and subject to refinement upon access to fuller peer financials or company-specific operating metrics.
